commonMistakes.tr: Yanlis OU'da islem yapmak, disabled kullanicida sifre reset sonrasi login beklemek ve locked user ile expired password karistirmak yaygindir.
commonMistakes.en: Working in the wrong OU, expecting login after reset on a disabled account, and confusing locked vs expired password are common.

verificationChecks.tr: Account sekmesi, Member Of, Attribute Editor, replication ve effective group membership kontrol et.
verificationChecks.en: Check Account tab, Member Of, Attribute Editor, replication, and effective group membership.

expertTips.tr: Group membership replikasyon gecikmesi ve UPN/mail/proxyAddress karisikligi sik sorun kaynagidir.
expertTips.en: Group membership replication delay and UPN/mail/proxyAddress confusion are frequent root causes.
